svg.aria-label: AgentRQ workspace forks: claude has six tasks in the api workspace, so you fork it into api-fork and move three tasks there. codex works the fork while claude works api, both sharing the same memory, skills and settings; when the fork's tasks are done you merge it back, its three tasks return to api with their threads, and the agents celebrate.

svg.text: A second agent takes tasks in parallel.
